lead.headline: Pickens 11.7 as Dallas blow a 21-point lead; down 65.6 to 26.6
lead.deck: Rice 3.9 on the bench in Buffalo's rain. Tuten has not practised; Likely limited twice. The Sunday fallbacks stand.
lead.body: Bad news first. George Pickens caught 5 of 9 for 67 as Dallas lost a 21-point lead and fell 39-38 to Philadelphia on a 60-yard field goal — 11.7 against 15.1 projected. Rashee Rice had 2 catches for 19 on your bench in Buffalo's 13-10 rain game, so the projection's FLEX call was right. JuiceJam lead 65.6 to 26.6. Bhayshul Tuten has not practised all week, and Isaiah Likely was limited twice; Friday's reports come this afternoon. Chris Boswell kicks for Pittsburgh at 14:00 today with Mason Rudolph, now the starter for the rest of the season. Sunday's plan is unchanged: if Tuten sits, start Jonathan Taylor; if Likely sits, add Kyle Pitts Sr. and drop Aaron Jones Sr. ESPN gives you 31%.
